evidence: Has TX fees and policy label; modifies src/txmempool.cpp and src/policy/fees/mempool_estimator.cpp.
rationale: Fixes an issue where CTxMemPool::removeForBlock matched transactions only by txid, causing unmined witness variants to be marked as mined and skewing fee estimator coverage health statistics. While an inherent false positive in weight counts is corrected, witness divergence with matching txids is an uncommon edge case.
